svg.text: When every account is full, use API credits
While every account is full, puts apiKeyHelper in
~/.claude/settings.json. If that file syncs to other machines,
they get the line too. Needs an API key on an account first.

svg.text: Hold a dragged card over another to link them. Two Claude Code
sessions become partners that hand each other tasks; with Codex
or omp, one hands the other its latest result.
Keep remote control after a switch
When the panel switches accounts, sessions that had remote
control on get it back once they are idle, under the account
An agent card's Details shows its project's commits per day for
the last twelve weeks, every branch and author, as GitHub draws
Each new Codex session is sent the project's Claude Code memory
index, up to 10 KB of MEMORY.md, so OpenAI receives it too.
Codex can read the rest of the file and the notes it lists.
